This command appends the alias to the `/etc/bash.bashrc` file and then reloads the configuration. Make sure you have the necessary permissions to modify the file.

I cannot execute commands directly on your system. However, I can guide you on how to run the command you provided.

To execute the command, open your terminal and run:
